items.title: Intel (INTC) Is Up 6.1% After $20 Billion Equity Raise To Fund AI Build-Out - What's Changed
items.summary: Earlier in August 2026, Intel completed a US$20.00 billion follow-on equity offering of about 210,526,315 common shares at US$95.00 each, reshuffling a broad syndicate of co-lead underwriters including major global banks. The upsized share sale marks a clear shift in Intel’s capital approach, prioritizing fresh equity over additional debt to fund its capital-intensive manufacturing and AI infrastructure build-out.
